limitations: Restricted to the pure fourteen-qubit graph state on the Heawood incidence graph.
Balanced 7-versus-7 partitions only; orientations are counted separately.
No extensions to larger projective planes, noise, weighted gates, or asymptotic cut laws.
Historical priority beyond examined literature and indexed records is not established.
scientific_integrity: Exact finite theorem: complete 3432 labelled balanced bipartitions checked by two separately constructed GF(2) implementations and an analytic graph-state Schmidt-spectrum argument. Existing cut-rank/entropy principle is credited. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Complete balanced-cut entanglement census of the Heawood graph state
